raw:
```sql
SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN "GOT" >= 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(*) AS abnormal_rate
FROM main."Laboratory"
WHERE YEAR("Date") = 1997 
    AND "Date" <= DATE '1997-06-30'
    AND "GOT" IS NOT NULL
```
